findings.evidence: In codex_argv_switches, _CODEX_FLAGS checks exact membership (arg in _CODEX_FLAGS), matching flags like --profile <name> or --local-provider <name>, but not inline forms such as --profile=<name> or --local-provider=<name>, unlike -c and --config which explicitly support both whitespace and '=' delim
findings.title: codex_argv_switches does not inspect flags passed with inline equals

findings.evidence: shipped_table() reads and decodes vendors.toml via resources.files on every call without caching at module scope. Review execution reuses plan.vendor_table so runtime overhead during reviews is avoided, but repeated calls in test suites or ad-hoc table lookups perform redundant file I/O.
findings.title: shipped_table re-reads and re-parses vendors.toml on every call

findings.evidence: VendorTable is decorated with @dataclass(frozen=True), but providers, orgs, opencode, and pairs contain standard mutable dict objects rather than immutable mappings (such as MappingProxyType), allowing callers to modify table mappings in place and desynchronize the digest property.
findings.title: VendorTable declared frozen but holds mutable dict fields
